title: FT8 CQ-to-Answer Ratio
dataSources: FT8 spots (`ft8:spot`), JS8Call messages (`js8call:message`), PSKReporter receptions (`pskreporter:spot`), Direwolf TNC telemetry (`direwolf:packet`), and NOAA APT pass events (`noaaapt:pass`).
app: Weak-signal and decoder telemetry from WSJT-X FT8, JS8Call, PSKReporter, Direwolf TNC, NOAA APT pass schedulers, and station-control scripts sent to Splunk HEC via APIs, ADIF/log exports, and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ft8:spot
| search mode=FT8
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count(eval(msg_type="CQ")) as cq_calls count(eval(answered="true")) as answered by _time band
| eval answer_pct=if(cq_calls>0,round(100*answered/cq_calls,1),0)
| sort - _time
description: Examines FT8 CQ answer rate by band.
value: CQ answer rate is a grounded way to compare how operator timing and band choice affect results.
implementation: Send FT8 CQ answer rate by band events to `index=personal` with the fields used in this SPL and review the outliers or trend breaks regularly.
visualization: Table or chart of FT8 CQ answer rate by band, depending on the selected time range.
grandmaExplanation: It turns what is happening with FT8 CQ answer rate by band, so odd changes stand out quickly.
